note: The first carousel built from REAL captures of the real app rather than drawings. It became possible only once marketing/demo/ seeded a fictional world in the staging project: six invented Kabul salons, invented reviews and offers, one throwaway demo account. Nothing on these screens belongs to a real salon or a real customer, and the app is the live prod-release build, so what a viewer sees is what she gets. Dari only for the screens themselves — the Pashto slides carry the Pashto captures. Facts unchanged: Kabul only, no App Store (iOS still in review), no discount claimed by the copy (the offers visible in the app are the demo salons' own).
